articles.title: Cultural Center in Vaison-la-Romaine / Tectoniques
articles.summary: The project is located on former vineyard land converted into a housing estate. The installation of a cultural facility in this fragmented peri-urban context, with no direct connection to the public realm, led to the search for an inward-looking layout. This is informed as much by the cloister and the Roman domus as by certain agricultural archetypes such as the Provençal mas. The building is set back from the plot boundaries to create a planted forecourt.

articles.title: From Desert Heat to Northern Winters: How Container Architecture Adapts Across the United States
articles.summary: Far from simply transporting goods from A to B, shipping containers have become a go-to building material across the US, forming the basis of everything from tiny homes to container pools, site offices to workshops. But given the size of the country, and the range of climates found within its borders, the approach to container architecture can vary significantly from state to state, even county to county.

articles.title: Heritage as Urban Anchor: Beimen and the Redesign of Taipei's Gateway District
articles.summary: The North Gate of Taipei, also known as Beimen, stands not only as a reminder of the city's complex history but also as a witness to the changing urban landscape around it and its shifting attitudes towards the urban spaces bordering heritage buildings. Initially a Chinese imperial frontier, spared from demolition during the Japanese colonial dominion, crowded by overpasses and highways in the postwar modernization efforts, it has recently regained its prominent status through the development of the plaza that now frames it. articles.summary: BAG begins with a contradiction: a temporary construction system used to establish a permanent presence. In Al Muhammadiyah, Riyadh , a leased plot carried a former restaurant, its drive-thru lane and a parking yard. Nothing on the site was worth preserving in any heritage sense, and nothing on it was worth demolishing in any economic one.

articles.title: Kian Residence / Kamat & Rozario Architecture
articles.summary: The brief for this project was unlike most urban residential commissions. The client family, now spanning three generations, had lived on the site for many years and was deeply rooted in the neighborhood. Their primary aspiration was to create a home that remained connected to the street and the community they knew so well.

articles.title: Wave Cube / Scenic Architecture Office
articles.summary: Wave Imaginary — Whether in literature or science, waves are both ubiquitous and mysterious. In the everyday environment of Earth, only a few visible continuous media generate observable waves, such as water waves, while experiences at the human scale are even rarer, with surfers being among the few who can enter the interior of ocean waves. As a man-made structure, architecture is formed through static systems that create fixed spaces to meet human needs for activities and rest within flat surfaces. articles.title: Campeche Houses / Terra e Tuma Arquitetos Associados

There is no counterweighted base, just four legs that support the lamp head as if it's a tabletop. The form demands commitment, sitting directly above whatever you're reading.
